$comment: Buildings programme Stage 1 — the shared terrain MATERIAL library (docs/DESIGN_Building_Interiors.md §3c, the starter table; values are placeholders to tune). A terrain folder's own materials.json overrides entries by name. sight = transmittance 0..1 (multiplied along a line); resistanceMmRhaPerM = ballistic resistance per metre of thickness (§3d P2); soundDb = attenuation per crossing; blocksMovement = goes into the navmesh.

surfaceThermalClasses.$comment: CE-4662 (Thermal Drivers TD-9, lane ruling R-5065) — the thermal class of a ground SURFACE (TerrainSurfaceType by its lower-case name) and of bare ground with no surface ('ground'); thermalClass on a material is the same fixed list (TerrainThermalClass.All). A DRIVER for the image generator's thermal model, never a temperature.

tree-trunk.$comment: CE-4369 (R-4190 T-1/T-6): a lone tree trunk, r 0.3 m — stops small arms

rubble.$comment: CE-4391 S-2 (UTM §8.2 B-9): the mound a collapsed building leaves — broken masonry and soil, stops small arms in a metre
